description: This file manages device pairing notification logic, including subscription handling, notification triggering, and periodic polling for pending device pairing requests, specifically for Telegram integration.

methods.name: formatPendingRequests
methods.description: Formats a list of pending device pairing requests into a human-readable string.

methods.name: armPairNotifyOnce
methods.description: Arms a one-time notification for device pairing requests on Telegram.

methods.name: handleNotifyCommand
methods.description: Handles user commands to enable, disable, or check status of pairing notifications.

methods.name: registerPairingNotifierService
methods.description: Registers a background service that periodically polls for pending device pairing requests and sends notifications.
